answer: Iteration-Stamped Task Ledger. Each identity must publish a fresh solution to a random seed-derived challenge before its next transaction; the ledger hashes prior answers into the seed, so replaying an old response fails verification and an echo of another agent's work is detected. Attacker cost is one novel compute-bound solution per identity per cycle, which scales linearly and cannot be copied. A sonnet-length audit trail per epoch anchors the chain; an onyx marker uniquely binds each pass.
